speaker: אלהים
actions: they.will.become signs / appointed times / days / years
gloss: let.it.be luminaries … they.will.become (into) signs and.(into) appointed times and (into) days and years
basis: After Elohim said let there be luminaries, a weqatal states what they will be for. Not raised to predictive: it is the stated function of the lights in the same making-speech.

speaker: אלהים
actions: let.us.make humankind | that.they.may.rule
gloss: let.us.make humankind … that.they.may.rule over the.fish of the.sea …
basis: Elohim states an act of making and a purpose of ruling. Candidate: intended act in the making-speech, not a prediction of a later day.

speaker: יהוה אלהים
actions: you.will.die
condition: eat from the tree of the knowledge of good and evil
time: ביום — on the.day of your eating from it
gloss: not you.must.eat from it … on the.day eat you from it surely.(die) you.will.die
basis: YHWH God commanded the man. A yiqtol states the man will die on the day of eating from that tree. The death is presented as what will follow the condition. No later chapter is used.

speaker: יהוה אלהים
actions: I.will.make a helper corresponding to him
gloss: I.will.make for him a.helper like before him
basis: YHWH God said he will make a helper. First-person yiqtol of an act not yet done. Kept as candidate: not every divine I-will is raised to predictive.

speaker: יהוה אלהים
actions: you.will.go on your belly | you.will.eat dust all the days of your life
condition: you.have.done this (stated as grounds, not as a future if)
gloss: [are].cursed you … on belly your you.will.go … dust you.will.eat all the.days your.life your
basis: YHWH God said to the snake. Two yiqtols state how the snake will go and what it will eat for the days of its life. The participle cursed you is the accompanying verdict, not a later-book meaning.

speaker: יהוה אלהים
actions: I.will.put enmity between you and the woman, and between your offspring and her offspring | he will.bruise you, head | you will.bruise him, heel
gloss: enmity I.will.put between you and between the woman and between offspring your and between offspring her | he he will.bruise.you head | you you will.bruise.him heel
basis: Same speech as GEN 3:14. Three yiqtols: YHWH will put enmity; he (the woman’s offspring, הוא) will bruise the snake as to the head; the snake will bruise him as to the heel. No identity of הוא is supplied from later text. No fulfillment is recorded.

speaker: יהוה אלהים
actions: I.will.increase your pain and your pregnancy | you.will.bear children with pain | your desire will be toward your husband | he will.rule over you
gloss: I.will.increase pain your and pregnancy your | with pain you.will.bear children | [will.be].to husband your desire your | he he.will.rule over you
basis: To the woman he said. First- and second- and third-person yiqtols (and a nominal clause of desire) state what will hold for her. No later text is used.

speaker: יהוה אלהים
actions: the ground is cursed because of you | you will.eat of it in pain all the days of your life | it will cause thorns and thistles to sprout for you | you will.eat the vegetation of the field | you will.eat food by the sweat of your face until you return to the ground | to dust you.will.return
time: all the.days your.life; until you return to the ground
gloss: [is].cursed the ground because of you | in pain you will.eat.it all the.days your.life your | thorn[s] and thistle[s] it.will.cause.to.sprout for you | you.will.eat the.vegetation of the.field | by the.sweat your.face your you.will.eat food until | to dust you.will.return
basis: To Adam he said. Yiqtol and weqatal state eating, sprouting, and returning to dust. The two-lists seam cut this speech at you.ate (wayyiqtol); the catalog reads the remaining clauses of 3:17–19 from MACULA anyway. No later text is used.

speaker: יהוה אלהים
actions: he.will.take from the tree of life | he.will.eat | he.will.live לעולם
gloss: he.should.stretch.out hand his | he.will.take also from the.tree of.(the) life | he.will.eat | he.will.live forever of.perpetuity
basis: YHWH God said what would follow if the man reached out to the tree of life. Candidate: a stated chain that the following narrative then prevents, not yet raised to a standing prediction of what will happen.

speaker: יהוה
actions: if you do well — lifting.up | if you do not do well — sin is crouching at the door | its desire is toward you | you will.rule over it
gloss: if you.will.do.well lifting.up | if not you.will.do.well to the door sin [is].crouching | to you desire its | you you.will.rule over it
basis: YHWH said to Cain. Two אם-clauses plus yiqtol תמשל. The speech states what will hold if Cain does well or not. No later text is used. Lifting.up is MACULA’s gloss of שאת; the catalog does not supply a meaning for that noun.

speaker: יהוה
actions: you are cursed from the ground | when you till the ground it will not again give its produce to you | you will.be a wanderer and a fugitive on the earth
gloss: [are].cursed you from the ground … you.will.till (et) the ground | not it.will.repeat to.give produce its to you | a.wanderer and a.fugitive you.will.be on the earth
basis: YHWH said (4:10 he.said). Yiqtols state what the ground will not give and what Cain will be. The participle cursed you is the verdict in the same speech.

speaker: קין
actions: I.will.be.hidden from before you | I.will.be a wanderer and a fugitive on the earth | every one who finds me will.kill.me
gloss: from before you I.will.be.hidden | I.will.be a.wanderer and a.fugitive on the earth | every [one who].finds.me he will.kill.me
basis: Cain said to YHWH. Part restates 4:12; part adds whoever finds me will kill me. Candidate: human speech of what will happen, not raised to the same status as YHWH’s yiqtols in 4:11–12.

speaker: יהוה
actions: anyone who kills Cain will.be.avenged sevenfold
gloss: any [one.who].kills Cain sevenfold he.will.be.avenged
basis: YHWH said to him. Hophal yiqtol יקם states what will be done to one who kills Cain. The sign in the next clause is narrator action, not this record.

speaker: למך
actions: Cain will.be.avenged sevenfold | Lamech seventy and seven
gloss: sevenfold he.will.be.avenged Cain | Lamech seventy and seven
basis: Lamech said to his wives. The yiqtol about Cain repeats YHWH’s 4:15 wording. The clause Lamech seventy and seven has no verb in MACULA. Candidate: human speech; not raised because YHWH already said the Cain line, and Lamech’s number is not a conjugated coming-act.

speaker: למך
actions: this one will.comfort us from our work and from the pain of our hands from the ground
gloss: this.[one] he will.comfort.us from work our and from the.pain our.hands our from the ground which he has.cursed.it Yahweh
basis: Lamech named his son Noah, saying. Piel yiqtol ינחמנו states what this one will do. The relative clause YHWH has cursed the ground is qatal (situation named, not a new coming act). Candidate: human naming-speech, not YHWH speaking. No later chapter is used to say whether the comfort happened.

speaker: יהוה
actions: my spirit will not remain in humankind לעולם | his days will be 120 years
gloss: not it.will.remain spirit my in (the) humankind forever of.perpetuity | they.will.be days his one.hundred and twenty year[s]
basis: YHWH said. Yiqtol לא ידון and weqatal והיו ימיו. The catalog does not decide what 120 years measures. No later verse is used.

speaker: יהוה
actions: I.will.wipe humankind from on the surface of the ground, from humankind unto animals, creeping things, and birds
place: from on the surface of the ground
gloss: I.will.wipe (et) (the) humankind which from on the.surface of the.ground from humankind unto animal[s] unto creeping.thing[s] and unto the.bird[s] of the.heavens
basis: YHWH said. First-person yiqtol אמחה. 6:8–9 (Noah found favor; these are the accounts) are narrator and are not this record.

speaker: אלהים
actions: the end of all flesh is coming before me | I am about to destroy them with the earth | I am about to bring the flood water on the earth to destroy all flesh under the heavens | all that is on the earth will die
place: on the earth / under the heavens
gloss: [the].end of.all flesh [is].coming before to me | [am].about to.destroy.them with the earth | [am].about.to.bring (et) the flood water on the earth | all that it.will.die
basis: Elohim said to Noah. The coming-act clauses are בא (gloss: is.coming), participles about.to.destroy / about.to.bring, and yiqtol יגוע. Ark-making clauses in between are not this record. המבול מים is the clause’s own wording, not a title supplied from elsewhere.

speaker: אלהים
actions: I.will.establish my covenant with you | you will.go into the ark, you and your sons and your wife and your sons’ wives with you
gloss: I.will.establish (et) covenant my with you | you.will.go into the ark you and sons your and wife your and the.wives your.sons your with you
basis: Same Elohim-to-Noah speech. MACULA glosses והקמתי as I.will.establish (form tagged qatal). Weqatal ובאת you.will.go. No later covenant passage is used.

speaker: אלהים
actions: two of everything they.will.come to you | male and female they.will.be
gloss: two of everything they.will.come to you to preserve.alive | male and female they.will.be
basis: Third-person yiqtols in the same speech (they.will.come / they.will.be). Candidate: not first-person YHWH-act, and 6:19 you.will.bring is the assigned work left out. No later verse is used.

speaker: יהוה
actions: in seven more days I am about to bring rain on the earth forty days and forty nights | I will wipe all existence that is on the surface of the ground
place: on the earth / on the surface of the ground
gloss: to days yet seven I [am].about.to.bring.rain on the earth forty day[s] and forty night[s] | I.will.wipe (et) all the existence which from on the.surface of the.ground
basis: YHWH said to Noah (7:1). Coming-act clauses only: participle about.to.bring.rain; MACULA glosses מחיתי as I.will.wipe (form tagged qatal). Nested עשיתי I.have.made is relative to יקום and is not a coming act. 7:1 go / 7:2–3 you.will.take are excluded as imperatives and assigned work. 7:5–24 is narrator fulfillment, not added here.
